title: Where does PHI travel?
objective: Learners follow claims data hop by hop from the claims system to analytics and an outside care-management vendor, and see which safeguards keep protected health information away from hops that do not need it.

recommended.why: A record card travelling hop by hop makes the flow concrete: unneeded fields light up red, get cut or tokenised at checkpoints, and the opted-out member is stopped at the vendor gate.

alternative.why: A travelling record versus the data-flow matrix: which would you show a privacy officer?

assumptions: Illustrative teaching example, not legal or compliance advice; which fields each hop needs is a simplified judgement
The HIPAA minimum necessary principle in plain words: use or share only the protected health information a task actually needs (the real rule has exceptions, for example for treatment)
A field exposure is a raw field present at a hop whose purpose does not need it; the score counts one per field, hop and member record
Three fictional members travel together; Member 3 has opted out of care-management outreach, and the vendor has a signed business associate agreement (BAA)
The sandbox, dashboard and vendor export each receive data from the data platform

Without de-identification, filtering has to keep member ID, date of birth and address on the analytics path, because they are the only source of a member key, age band and region; they still count as exposures
De-identification replaces name and member ID with a token, date of birth with an age band and address with a region; these derived values are not counted as exposures
Salesforce names show where each hop could live; they are not a reference architecture. Times are playback seconds
units: exposure score: count of field exposures (field x hop x member record)
checkDescription: At every hop and for every record, exposures are exactly the fields present but not needed; switching any safeguard on never raises exposure at any hop; all three on gives zero; and with the consent check on the opted-out member never reaches the vendor.

learnerPrompts.predict: Before you switch anything on: which single safeguard will remove the most exposure, and which hop will still leak with only that one on?
learnerPrompts.explain: Turn on minimum necessary filtering alone. Why does the dashboard still see date of birth and address, and which second safeguard fixes that?
